risk_note: RV1 by path (catalog). An expired, cleared or foreign search session starts a new one and returns the page the cursor asks for, with an empty issued set, no error (BR-PROD-07 细则「会话异常」, D10-485, FU-SEARCH-EXPIRED-PAGE); search.ts answered page 1 before. Changed filters or sort still start from page 1 while the session row exists: after eviction the change cannot be seen, because the cursor holds only session id and page, so clients drop the cursor when filters change (comment in search.ts). A deep page with no remembered union cursor walks from page 1, at most SEARCH_MAX_PAGE_NO union calls. No money moves. verify:fast exit 0. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
